property_summary: For every token transfer call, the reference C forwards the canonical transferFrom(address,address,uint256) selector to the target contract; the bug instead encodes the truncated selector transferFrom(address,address,uint), so a recording helper observes a different calldata selector.
change_summary: Move the transferFrom selector string into a different namespace (transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transferFrom(address,address,uint)), changing the requested selector.
